title: Art collections
subtitle: 藝術收藏、館藏、作品群——哪些說法最接近 art collections？
description: 藝術收藏、館藏、作品群——哪些說法最接近 art collections？

words.note: 表示博物館擁有、保管或管理的藝術品。和 art collections 在博物館語境中非常接近。

exercises.original: The exhibition includes several paintings from the museum's art collection.
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition includes several paintings from the museum's art collection.

exercises.original: The museum's art collections include more than 20,000 objects.
exercises.upgrade: The museum's art collections include more than 20,000 objects.

options.explanation: 表示博物館所持有的作品總體。

exercises.original: Researchers were given access to the museum's art collection.
exercises.upgrade: Researchers were given access to the museum's art collection.

options.explanation: 不一定包含未展出的作品。

words.note: 比 museum holdings 更廣，可以指博物館、基金會、企業或私人收藏者所擁有的藝術品。

exercises.original: The foundation's art collection grew rapidly during the 1990s.
exercises.upgrade: The foundation's art collection grew rapidly during the 1990s.

exercises.original: The bank has one of the country's largest corporate art collections.
exercises.upgrade: The bank has one of the country's largest corporate art collections.

exercises.original: The collector donated part of his art collection to the university.
exercises.upgrade: The collector donated part of his art collection to the university.

words.meaning: 藝術作品收藏；作品集合
words.note: 非常直接的改寫，語義清楚，適合一般和正式語境。
words.example: 是否只是需要最直接地把 art collections 改寫成「藝術作品的集合」？

exercises.original: The centre owns several important art collections.
exercises.upgrade: The centre owns several important art collections.

exercises.original: The university has art collections from different historical periods.
exercises.upgrade: The university has art collections from different historical periods.

exercises.original: The archive includes art collections from several local artists.
exercises.upgrade: The archive includes art collections from several local artists.

words.note: 較描述性、較中性。表示被放在一起考慮、展示或討論的一批藝術品。

exercises.original: The curator divided the art collection into thematic sections.
exercises.upgrade: The curator divided the art collection into thematic sections.

exercises.original: Several small art collections were displayed in separate rooms.
exercises.upgrade: Several small art collections were displayed in separate rooms.

options.explanation: 可指展示，但不等同 group itself。

exercises.original: The exhibition brings together different art collections around a single theme.
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition brings together different art collections around a single theme.

options.explanation: 如果來源是博物館才適合。

words.note: 表示一位藝術家、一個時期或一個創作脈絡中的一整組作品。和一般 art collection 不完全相同，但在談藝術家作品整體時非常接近。

exercises.original: The museum owns a major art collection by the painter.
exercises.upgrade: The museum owns a major art collection by the painter.

options.explanation: 同一藝術家的一整批作品。
也可但不突出同一藝術家。

exercises.original: The exhibition examines the artist's art collection from the final decade of her career.
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition examines the artist's art collection from the final decade of her career.

options.explanation: 一段創作時期的作品整體。

exercises.original: The institution acquired an important art collection by a single sculptor.
exercises.upgrade: The institution acquired an important art collection by a single sculptor.

words.note: 表示博物館或美術館長期持有、管理的核心收藏，和臨時展覽中的借展作品相對。

exercises.original: These paintings belong to the museum's main art collection.
exercises.upgrade: These paintings belong to the museum's main art collection.

exercises.original: Only a small part of the art collection is on display at any one time.
exercises.upgrade: Only a small part of the art collection is on display at any one time.

exercises.original: The new wing will house works from the museum's art collection.
exercises.upgrade: The new wing will house works from the museum's art collection.

words.note: 表示由博物館、大學、基金會、企業或其他機構持有和管理的藝術收藏。

exercises.original: The study compares art collections held by universities and foundations.
exercises.upgrade: The study compares art collections held by universities and foundations.

exercises.original: Many public art collections are being digitised.
exercises.upgrade: Many public art collections are being digitised.

options.explanation: 若全部是 museums 才更精確。

exercises.original: The database records art collections owned by major cultural organisations.
exercises.upgrade: The database records art collections owned by major cultural organisations.

words.note: 表示畫廊或美術館擁有、管理或展示的作品集合。

exercises.original: The gallery's art collection includes several important modernist paintings.
exercises.upgrade: The gallery's art collection includes several important modernist paintings.

exercises.original: Works from the art collection are rotated regularly.
exercises.upgrade: Works from the art collection are rotated regularly.

exercises.original: The gallery expanded its art collection through several major acquisitions.
exercises.upgrade: The gallery expanded its art collection through several major acquisitions.

words.meaning: 私人收藏；私人藝術收藏
words.note: 表示由私人收藏家、家庭或非公營實體持有的藝術品集合。

exercises.original: Several paintings were borrowed from private art collections.
exercises.upgrade: Several paintings were borrowed from private art collections.

exercises.original: The auction includes works from a number of art collections owned by families.
exercises.upgrade: The auction includes works from a number of art collections owned by families.

exercises.original: Many important works remain in private art collections.
exercises.upgrade: Many important works remain in private art collections.

words.meaning: 集合起來的作品；一批作品
words.note: 表示被收集、整理或組合在一起的一批作品。較描述性，適合不想強調正式館藏身份時使用。

exercises.original: The exhibition presents an art collection assembled over forty years.
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition presents an art collection assembled over forty years.

exercises.original: The collector's art collection reflects decades of careful buying.
exercises.upgrade: The collector's art collection reflects decades of careful buying.

exercises.original: The show brings together art collections from several sources.
exercises.upgrade: The show brings together art collections from several sources.

options.explanation: 通常同一藝術家／創作脈絡。

words.meaning: 策展式收藏；經挑選整理的作品集合
words.note: 表示經過選擇、組織、主題化或策展思考的一組作品。比一般 art collections 更突出選擇與策展邏輯。

exercises.original: The website presents art collections organised around particular themes.
exercises.upgrade: The website presents art collections organised around particular themes.

exercises.original: The gallery created several small art collections for its online platform.
exercises.upgrade: The gallery created several small art collections for its online platform.

exercises.original: The publication features carefully selected art collections from the archive.
exercises.upgrade: The publication features carefully selected art collections from the archive.

words.meaning: 藝術檔案收藏；藝術資料庫
words.note: 在某些語境中可指保存藝術作品、圖像、文件或藝術相關材料的集合。和 art collections 有重疊，但更偏保存和檔案管理。

exercises.original: The university's art collection includes photographs, sketches, letters, and prints.
exercises.upgrade: The university's art collection includes photographs, sketches, letters, and prints.

options.explanation: 包含作品與文件資料，檔案性強。
也可部分成立，但 archives 更精確。

exercises.original: Researchers use the institution's art collection to study the artist's working process.
exercises.upgrade: Researchers use the institution's art collection to study the artist's working process.

options.explanation: 研究創作過程需要檔案資料。
可能但不突出文件研究。

exercises.original: The centre digitised its art collection so scholars could access rare documents remotely.
exercises.upgrade: The centre digitised its art collection so scholars could access rare documents remotely.

falseSynonyms.zh: 展覽不等於收藏 Exhibition 是把作品展示出來的活動或展示形式；collection 是作品本身的集合。
陳列不等於收藏 Display 指展示方式或當前被展示的作品，不代表整體收藏。
畫廊不等於收藏 Gallery 是場所或機構；collection 是其中的作品。
博物館不等於館藏 Museum 是機構／場所，不是作品集合本身。
作品集不等於一般藝術收藏 Portfolio 通常是一位藝術家、設計師或創作者用來展示能力的精選作品集。
目錄不等於收藏 Catalogue 是列出收藏或展覽內容的記錄／出版物。
檔案不一定是藝術收藏 Archives 通常包括文件、照片、信件、記錄等，範圍和 art collection 不同。
清單不等於收藏 Inventory 是列出物品的清單，不是物品本身。
